title: Cross-sectoral ambulatory emergency care
summary: In response to the increasing utilisation of emergency departments and emergency medical services, the German healthcare policy has formulated recommendations for a navigation of less urgent patients. According to these recommendations, patients with less urgent medical need should be redirected to the ambulatory care. So far, only a few international studies for the navigation of emergency department and emergency medical service patients to outpatient care structures are available. These can hardly be transferred to the German situation due to different healthcare systems. An evaluation of interventional approaches seems much-needed - this is the aim of the SaN project.
conditions: Study does not focus on specific diagnoses

interventions.name: Patients in the participating districts who utilze the 112, 116117, the emergency medical service or the participating emergency departments are assessed and assigned to a care level according to their complaints.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients of all ages and genders in the participating districts, who utilize the 112, 116117, emergency medical service or the participating emergency departments during project period.
Exclusion criteria:
No exclusion criterias.
